title: MenuMint
description: 🚀 Introducing MenuMint — Beautiful Digital Menus. One QR. 🍽️              📱  Say goodbye to expensive paper menus and reprinting costs! MenuMint helps restaurants, cafes, and bakeries create interactive digital menus with instant QR codes in under 2 minutes.
longDescription:
✨ What MenuMint offers:
• ⚡ 2-Minute Setup: Add your dishes, select a theme, and get a high-res QR code ready to print.
• 🔄 Real-Time Updates: Change prices or mark dishes as "Sold Out" instantly without reprinting.
• 🥗 Smart Dietary Tags: Easy filters for Veg, Non-Veg, Jain, Vegan, and Chef Bestsellers.
• 📱 Zero App Download: Diners simply scan the QR and browse a smooth, mobile-optimized menu.
• 🎨 Custom Styles: Curated themes (Modern Dark, Warm Amber, Artisanal Cafe) tailored to your venue.

🌐 Try the Live Demo: https://manumint.vercel.app/

Would love to hear your thoughts and feedback! 👇

#MenuMint #DigitalMenu #QRCodeMenu #RestaurantTech #FoodTech #SaaS #ProductLaunch
features: 2-minute instant QR setup, real-time price & stock updates, smart dietary filters (Veg/Jain/Spicy), and sleek mobile-first themes.
